clue.text: With time Notre Dame can be redesigned as exhibition centre

explanation.walkthrough: The Tate Modern is a major London art gallery, housed in a former power station; 'can be redesigned' is the anagram signal, 'With' a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The London gallery is a building where art is exhibited, so it is literally a centre for exhibitions.

clue.text: Stomachs the rise of pornography

clue.text: Part of plant to care for with running water, say

clue.text: This is how to get full marks, believe me

definitions.text: This is how to get full marks

explanation.surface: A teacher's emphatic advice on scoring perfectly.
explanation.walkthrough: The first reading is cryptic: making no mistake earns full marks; the second is the everyday intensifier.

clue.text: Left job without complaining

clue.text: Religious leader, source of support to the afflicted

clue.text: Old statesman gives hand with mission

clue.text: Little fellow in a minute returns to join family

clue.text: Arrange hearing for irritated solicitor

clue.text: Discounts frames for copies of artist's work

clue.text: Mentioning early education

clue.text: Book size
